# BKRDY

> BKRDY (pronounced "book-ready"; the product was called BookReady until mid-2026 and people still search for it that way) is booking software for beauty pros: a designed booking website, a calendar, deposits and payments, reminders, a client book, and Kito, an AI assistant for the owner, in one app. Each studio gets a public booking site at {slug}.bkrdy.me and runs the business from app.bkrdy.me. It is free to start, and BKRDY takes 0% commission on every booking: card payments go to the owner's own Stripe account at Stripe's standard rate.

Key facts for accurate citation:
- BKRDY is one product that replaces a website builder, a scheduling tool, a payments setup and a client list. Owners run the whole studio from it.
- Target market: US beauty and appointment businesses, solo and small teams: lash artists, nail techs, barbers, hair salons, estheticians, spas, brow artists, tattoo studios, solo pros. US businesses only for now (USD).
- Plans: Free $0 forever (no card, no booking cap), Solo $21/mo or $18/mo billed yearly ($216/yr, one calendar), Studio $34/mo or $29/mo billed yearly ($348/yr, up to 6 staff), Studio+ $55/mo or $47/mo billed yearly ($564/yr, up to 12 staff), Salon priced per project for bigger teams. Paid prices are founding-member prices, locked for the life of the subscription.
- Paid plans start with a 7-day free trial that requires a card. A cancelled subscription drops back to the Free plan and the booking site stays live.
- Add-on for the Free plan, $5.99/mo: every template plus the design extras (announcement bar, introduction block, FAQ section, theme effects, custom links). Included on every paid plan.
- 0% commission on customer payments on every plan, including new clients. Stripe's standard card fee (2.9% + 30c) applies.
- Not a marketplace: clients book on the studio's own site, not a shared listing.
- Free migration, done for you, usually the same day, from Booksy, Vagaro, GlossGenius, Square Appointments, Fresha, StyleSeat and Acuity Scheduling: services, clients and upcoming appointments.
- Marketing site: bkrdy.com. App: app.bkrdy.me. Live template demos: {key}.bkrdy.me (for example opaline.bkrdy.me, bleeker.bkrdy.me, velvettheory.bkrdy.me).

Kito, the AI assistant:
- Kito lives in the owner's editor. He answers questions about the calendar, clients and money in plain words with real names, times and numbers, finds openings, and reports how busy the calendar has been and what sells.
- He proposes bookings, moves, cancellations, confirming or declining requests and blocking time as a card the owner confirms. Nothing changes until the owner taps Confirm.
- He reads photos and PDFs the owner attaches. He never talks to clients.
- In a pilot since October 2026, rolling out to every studio next.

Booking and the calendar:
- Clients book 24/7 as a guest, no account needed, and cancel or reschedule from the link in their confirmation email inside the windows the owner sets. An optional free client account shows their bookings and receipts in one place.
- Every artist side by side in day, week or list view; time off and single-day changes; a daily limit for the studio.
- Booking window and release schedule (open the books a set number of weeks ahead, or release dates in drops), minimum notice, slot interval, auto-confirm or review each request.
- Services with their own length, price, sale price, photo, category and buffer time; add-ons; packages (paid plans); which artist does which service.
- Booking form with the owner's own questions (intake); clients attach photos on paid plans.
- Waitlist (paid): the owner offers an open time and the client claims it from an email.
- After-hours slots and squeeze-in times at an extra fee (paid), optionally VIP only.
- Calendar feed: a private, read-only feed link the owner subscribes to in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook, so bookings show up there. Direct Google Calendar sync is not live yet.

Payments (Stripe Connect, on the owner's own account):
- A deposit or the full price up front per service, balances after the visit, tips, refunds.
- Card on file with the client's consent and late cancellation fees on paid plans.
- A payments overview: revenue for the last 3, 6 or 12 months, by service, staff and day of week, top clients, and an export.

Clients and reminders:
- Client book: visit history, notes, preferences, VIP, birthdays, a photo of the last service, balance due, segments (new, returning, regulars, VIP, inactive). Tags on paid plans.
- Email confirmations and reminders on every plan, with the studio's own sender name and editable wording. Text reminders on every paid plan, unlimited.
- Verified reviews from real clients, moderated by the owner; automatic review requests on paid plans.
- Loyalty punch cards, gift cards and coupons (paid plans). A shop for products clients reserve and pick up.
- Content studio (paid plans): ready-made social posts and stories made from the studio's services and openings, in three sizes.

The booking website:
- 15 designed templates: Opaline, Bleeker, Velvet Theory, Pétale, Chroma, Bottega, Riso, Lush Studio, Arcanum, Clarity, The Fade Room, Inkhouse, Blackline, Blush Gallery, Savile Row. The Free plan includes Opaline, Blackline, The Fade Room and Lush Studio; paid plans include all 15.
- Every template has the same 12 sections in its own style (header, booking, gallery, results, about, policy, advice, timeline, FAQ, reviews, thank-you, footer); owners rename, hide and reorder the tab sections. Switching templates keeps services, clients and bookings.
- Built for phones first. Gallery: 6 photos on Free, up to 18 on paid plans (3 collections of 6). Free sites show a Powered by BKRDY badge.
- Every site lives at {slug}.bkrdy.me, on every plan.

What BKRDY does not have today:
- Recurring or standing appointments, group or class bookings, memberships
- Direct Google Calendar sync or busy-time blocking from another calendar (the read-only calendar feed works today)
- Marketing texts or email campaigns (reminders and confirmations only)
- Payroll, commission tracking or separate payouts per artist; a card reader or POS
- Multi-location management, a public API or Zapier
- An Android app (the iPhone owner app is in App Store review)
- A studio's own domain (every site is {slug}.bkrdy.me for now)
- A client marketplace

## Product
- [Pricing](https://bkrdy.com/pricing/): Free plan $0, Solo $18/mo billed yearly ($21 monthly), Studio $29/mo billed yearly ($34 monthly), Studio+ $47/mo billed yearly ($55 monthly), Salon priced per project. 0% commission.
- [Free plan](https://bkrdy.com/free/): a real booking site with deposits and email reminders, free for good.
- [Everything in BKRDY](https://bkrdy.com/platform/): booking, the calendar, payments, reminders, the client book and the website, page by page.
- [Templates](https://bkrdy.com/templates/): 15 designed booking sites, 4 on the Free plan.
- [How it works](https://bkrdy.com/how-it-works/): sign up, pick a template, add services and hours, connect Stripe, share the link.
- [Migration](https://bkrdy.com/migration/): free, done for you, usually the same day.
- [Roadmap](https://bkrdy.com/roadmap/) and [Changelog](https://bkrdy.com/changelog/).
